[EN] Sorry friend. There's no access to the {@Rgn:84001}—not through here, anyway.

Look on the bright side, if you aren't getting through, neither are the argons.
[ES] Lo siento, amigo. No hay acceso a {@Rgn:84001}... al menos no por aquí.

Mírale el lado bueno, si tú no puedes pasar, los argons tampoco.
